body:
Out of Reality With MAL and Mxipr
T +0:35: I started to feel the Mal, it was mostly a sensation in the body, no visual effects yet. It was not very strong yet but it was a pleasant thickly and warm feeling.
T +0:50: Waiting for the feeling to get stronger and for the visual effects to start, I went outside to smoke a joint and drink some whiskey. I dont know if this was a good idea, because it made me feel calmer and I think it worked a bit against the working of Mal. During the joint I had the impression that there was somewhere in the distance a red eye staring at me. I dont know if this was something real. There were some mild visual effects, but not as strong as I hoped for and as I remembered from last time.
T +1:20 When the joint was over, I felt more the feeling of calmness that I know from joints, than that I felt the bodily sensations of Mal.
When the joint was over, I felt more the feeling of calmness that I know from joints, than that I felt the bodily sensations of Mal.
I think these 2 substances dont combine well. With other substances I sometimes had the expression that smoking a joint made it stronger and made it last longer. I had mild visual effects.
T +1:35 I went for a walk, hoping that the Mal would kick in. It was a nice walk and at the end I felt back the physical sensations of the Mal, but the feeling and the visual effects were still quite weak. I dont understand why it was still this weak.
T +2:15 Because the effects were still mild, I decided to take another dosage of 21mg Mal. Then I started doing some yoga and some breathing exercises in order to relax and because I know this can be nice when youve taken something.
T +2:40: The physical and visual effects started to get stronger. It was a nice feeling.
T +2:55: Now I decided that I wanted to try to combine this with Mxipr and this is were the experience got really strong. I took 70mg and then I started to watch a series.
T +3:15: All of a sudden the Mxipr hit and the experience got really strange and heavy. I didnt now anymore what reality was and it was as if I was sometimes inside the series, sometimes in my room, sometimes somewhere completely else. The room turned and sometimes it got bigger, sometimes smaller, sometimes it looked as if I didnt know what was above me and what beneath me and what was to the left of me and what right of me. It was now too difficult to continue watching the series so I put it off and tried sitting in my bed to see where I was.
I didnt recognize my own body, or it was as if I was detached of it. Sometimes it looked as if my mind was just floating, sometimes it appeared to me as if I had a totally different body and it looked as if I was an old woman to me and it was very confusing. I had the feeling of being outside reality and I didnt know where I was or what was real. Sometimes I recognized something of my room and then I want a bit back, but then it started turning again.
T + 4:15 I think this crazy state lasted this strong for about an hour. Eventually, I managed to get control of the situation and I managed to see that I was in my room with my body. When I looked at my watch, approximately 1h had passed. The room was still spinning heavily, but I was back in reality. I managed to go to the toilet and I put on some music. Now I felt calm and good and I noticed that when I closed my eyes, I saw geometrical patterns. In this state, I tried to play a game of chess online and it went well and to my surprise I even won. Playing chess with drugs is always funny. It was a very quick game but in my mind it was as if the game took at hours.
T +8:15 I went asleep. The effects were still there but I was tired.
T +10:15 I woke up. It was still spinning.
T +13:15 I woke up again. There were no effects anymore.
